intro: One slice of pepperoni pizza is an estimated 300 kcal. Most of the calories come from the crust, cheese and pepperoni.
diet: Yes, one or two slices of pizza fit your diet. The problem is it's easy to finish 4-5 slices without noticing. Decide your number first, say two slices, and add a salad. Go for thin crust to save calories.
tips: Put two slices on your plate, then close the box.
Choose thin crust with chicken or veggie toppings.
Have a salad or soup before the pizza.

swap.name: Thin crust chicken & veggie pizza (1 slice)
swap.why: Thinner crust and leaner toppings. You can have two slices for about the same calories as one and a half regular slices.

faq.a: In Malaysia, pepperoni at halal restaurants is usually made from beef or chicken.

faq.q: Can I eat leftover pizza the next day?
faq.a: Yes, keep it in the fridge. Reheat in a pan or air fryer so the crust gets crispy again.

faq.q: Thin crust or pan, which is more filling?
faq.a: Pan is thicker and fills you up faster, but it's higher in calories. Thin crust is lighter.
